# A small household budget. Column A holds the raw numbers, column B
# labels and totals, column C a couple of derived stats.
A1 = 1200
A2 = 340.5
A3 = 89
A4 = 15
B1 = "rent"
B2 = "groceries"
B3 = "internet"
B4 = "streaming"
C1 = =SUM(A1:A4)
C2 = =AVG(A1:A4)
C3 = =MAX(A1:A4)
C4 = =MIN(A1:A4)
D1 = =C1 / 2
D2 = =(C1 - A1) * 2
